llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a harmless local reference: it includes a shell script that prints documentation and does not contact external servers or ask for secrets. If you plan to install it, you can proceed with low risk — as best practice, quickly inspect the included script (scripts/script.sh) before running to confirm it matches the displayed content. If you do not want the agent to execute bundled scripts at all, avoid installing or invoking the skill.
